text: {"side":"artifact","claims":[{"text":"The event is a long-term dimming confined to plates from 1925 to 1952 (epoch 1925.15 to 1952.23), and the ac series dominates the listed points with negative offsets near -1 mag, which is the pattern a series-specific zero-point or seam problem would produce.","evidence_ids":["E-002","E-045","E-047","E-049","E-051","E-052","E-054","E-055"]},{"text":"Series zero points are far from the mean for the ac series (median -0.202 over 155 plates) and ax (-0.457), and the 1950s decade summary has a median offset of -0.491 with scatter 0.646, so the dip sits where plate-to-plate calibration is least stable.","evidence_ids":["E-016","E-018","E-011"]},{"text":"Known-issue checks flag the event's population heavily: 62 of 447 points are blend_suspect, 130 are shape_outlier, 41 are emulsion_non_blue, and 13 are plate_edge, so the trigger is not clean.","evidence_ids":["E-059","E-061","E-057","E-062"]},{"text":"Most listed dim points carry both BLEND_SUSPECT and SHAPE_OUTLIER tags (E-045, E-047, E-048, E-049, E-050, E-051, E-052, E-054, E-055), so a blend or a plate-defect shape could account for the dimming without any real stellar change.","evidence_ids":["E-045","E-047","E-048","E-049","E-050","E-051","E-052","E-054","E-055"]},{"text":"The event rests on 30 of 447 points chosen by a strongest-half-plus-sample rule, and the packet provides no per-plate check of the omitted 417 points, so a selection effect or unrepresentative sampling cannot be excluded; the packet also does not show a plate-offset test on the event's own plates, since the no_plate_offset check (E-065) is a global pass.","evidence_ids":["E-056","E-065"]}]}
